FlipOS vendored dependency

Project:
mGBA

Upstream:
https://github.com/mgba-emu/mgba.git

Vendored upstream commit:
c3c8e5e813f245028de118a56734e1dc0f35ce2a

Upstream branch at time of vendoring:
master

FlipOS carries a minimal source snapshot needed for the GBA Libretro build.
The only source patch is in CMakeLists.txt: the mgba_libretro target is built
STATIC instead of SHARED so FlipOS can link a self-contained ARM64 runner.

Do not update this dependency without testing the new revision on real
Miyoo Flip hardware.
